title: Evaluation of a finite set of inputs
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each of $m$ inputs, and choose a finite set $I$ of input indices. The AND gate returns $-1$ exactly when every input in $I$ has value $-1$, and otherwise returns $1$; the OR gate returns $-1$ exactly when some input in $I$ has value $-1$, and otherwise returns $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Each of the $m$ inputs is assigned a sign
$I$ is a finite set of input indices
